name: binary plist parse-serialize round-trip
description: This Logic Group targets the binary plist (bplist) round-trip path: parsing binary plist data via plist_from_bin (which delegates to parse_bin_node_at_index for recursive object tree construction with offset table lookups and reference counting), then serializing the resulting tree back to binary format via plist_to_bin (which uses serialize_plist for recursive tree traversal with circular reference detection and max nesting depth checks, write_dict/write_array for container serialization, and offset table construction). The round-trip exercises both the parser's length/size validation and the serializer's byte-level encoding, offset table generation, and object reference counting — areas prone to integer overflow and buffer handling bugs.
